expected.name: Hector Daniel Ramos
expected.description: Hector Daniel Ramos of Alhambra was taken into federal custody in a prosecution arising from the June 8, 2025 protest against immigration enforcement in downtown Los Angeles. Prosecutors alleged that defendants threw rocks and other objects at California Highway Patrol officers beneath the Main Street overpass. An October 29 Justice Department announcement identified Ramos among those in federal custody awaiting initial appearances. The April 20, 2026 court calendar subsequently listed him on bond. The reviewed sources do not establish a conviction or final sentence.

expected.charges: Obstructing, impeding and interfering with law enforcement during civil disorder (18 U.S.C. § 231(a)(3)); allegations
expected.sentence: Federal custody confirmed by October 29, 2025; listed on bond for the April 20, 2026 status conference in case 25-731. Exact arrest and release dates and actual detention duration are not established. No conviction or sentence verified in reviewed sources. The five-year statutory maximum stated in the charging announcement is not an imposed sentence.
